overview: The Medford School Committee approved a Statement of Interest submission to the Massachusetts School Building Authority core program and voted to increase tuition and staff pay rates for before and after school programs. The committee also received demonstrations of the new district website and mobile app and reviewed timetables for three open principal positions.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payrolls, and minutes from the March 20, 2023 regular meeting.

items.title: Evaluation Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the March 27, 2023 meeting, where the subcommittee selected the DESE superintendent evaluation template with custom indicators.

items.title: Rules and Policy Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Tabled the minutes of the March 28, 2023 meeting to allow committee members time to review them in their packets.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent highlighted student achievements, school events, community partnerships, and district notices.

items.title: Website and Mobile App Presentation
items.summary: Staff and student developers presented features of the newly redesigned district website and mobile application, and the committee recognized student team members with certificates.

items.title: MSBA Core Program Statement of Interest
items.summary: Approved the submission of a Statement of Interest to the Massachusetts School Building Authority Core Program for Medford High School.

items.title: Principal Searches and Timetables Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent outlined the search process and timeline to recruit new principals for Medford High School, Andrews Middle School, and Roberts Elementary School by mid-May.

items.title: Before and After School Program Report
items.summary: Approved proposed tuition rate and staff pay increases for the before and after school programs following a presentation on program finances and financial assistance model.
